text:
Zara: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Leadership asked for one auditable thread that lists exact launch windows, scope splits (Phase A vs Phase B), owners, and any "MUST" blockers. Paste single-line status + MUST/CAN_DEFER.
Mark: API Phase A = early Q3 (4-6w). Phase A = stable billing + core endpoints (chat/completions/embeddings) + SLA. Phase B = structured output/tool-calls + expanded models (Q4). Owner: Mark. MUST: signed SLA and final billing meter names. CAN_DEFER: noncritical admin endpoints.
Yvonne: Console split: Phase A (mid-Q3) = admin UX, rollout UI, per-route model pins, basic dashboards. Phase B (Q4) = Optimize panels, quantization controls, third-party APM link. Owner: Yvonne. MUST: rollout UI and model pinning. CAN_DEFER: APM link and full quantization matrix.
Carlos: Optimize advisor timeline: public beta = late-Q3, GA = Q4. Beta needs "sandboxed recommendations" showing estimated cost delta per suggestion. Owner: Carlos + Research. MUST: 3 production evals that demonstrate >=5% cost improvement on target workloads. CAN_DEFER: advanced recommendations ordering and multi-tenant RBAC in UI.
Anya: Gateway/Routing blocker detail: under mixed streaming + short sync bursts, we observe stalls from the token-bucket + batching interaction. Patch in PR, tests running. If green we'll promote to staging tonight and run 36h soak. Owner: Anya (Platform). Status line: in-PR -> CI -> staging. MUST/CAN_DEFER: CAN_DEFER if we gate with canary but prefer fix pre-GA.
Mark: Runtime note: Dedicated p99 tail validation required for Phase A. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 72h observation at each step. Gate condition: p99 <= 1.3x baseline AND no sustained OOMs. Owner: Runtime team (cc @Priya). MUST.
Zara: Leadership ask: can we dark-launch Console analytics widgets and hide them behind feature flags to reduce QA surface?
Yvonne: Yes. Dark-launch analytics widgets (flagged off) -> keeps code merged but not visible. Helps hit mid-Q3 window. Marking as CAN_DEFER for visibility.
legal-bot: Reminder: SLA redline deadline is next Tue 16:00 PT. Please ping @Legal to escalate.
Mark: Finance requirement: final pricing table & meter names needed 8 business days before Phase A GA. Owner: Finance (@Marcus). MUST.
Carlos: Infra ask for Optimize: need per-tenant batch quota to run 5 concurrent evals. Infra ticket opened (INFRA-3098). If quota not granted within 7bd, beta shifts ~2-3 weeks. Status: ticket open -> tagging infra. MUST for beta timing.
Anya: Quick dev note: the gateway fix reduces the stall repro by >90% in the staging reproducer; still running soak. If soak healthy I'll open canary rollout tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
Priya: (runtime) I'll watch the dedicated canary and publish the p99 dashboard link. If p99 exceeds gate, we'll auto-rollback and triage.
Zara: Action items captured: 1) Mark to confirm SLA/legal progress and tag Legal (ETA 7bd). 2) Marcus/Finance to lock pricing and meter names (ETA 8bd). 3) Anya to promote fix and report 36h soak metrics. 4) Priya/Runtime to run Dedicated canary after staging pass. 5) Yvonne to publish Console Phase A scope doc and mark deferrables. 6) Carlos to follow infra ticket for Optimize quota.
ops-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync Wed 09:00 PT.
Zara: Please update this thread with one-line slips (e.g., "Anya: gateway patch soak failed -> +3d") so Sales/Support get an accurate handoff. Thanks all. :pray:
